studio_ux.mental_model: Shifted from filling category inventory slots to 'I am playing with my wardrobe and AURA is helping me style it'.
studio_ux.first_class_navigation: Studio is now a primary destination in bottom tab navigation (Home, Closet, Studio, Inspiration, Profile) with direct /studio route support.

dual_mode_architecture.build_mode: Interactive horizontal swipe decks for Tops, Bottoms, and Footwear where garments dominate the screen and swipe changes immediately update the live outfit.
dual_mode_architecture.aura_mode: Proposes complete cohesive wardrobe combinations (LOOK 01, LOOK 02, LOOK 03) using the deterministic compatibility engine on the exact same visual canvas.

image_source_priority: 1. Clean product/catalog image already available -> preserve clean catalog asset directly.
2. User provides lifestyle/person photo -> isolate single garment via manual/suggested bounding crop.
3. Background removal / isolation uncertain -> reliable manual target selection fallback.
4. Zero appearance fabrication or silent replacement with generic stock fashion images.
garment_representation.model_governance_separation: Explicitly separated classification (aura-garment-v1-exp0015) from background segmentation; zero unverified claims of production-grade automatic segmentation made.

browsing_and_swipe_behavior.browsing_ux: Image-first visual browsing without modal interruptions or dense inventory lists.
browsing_and_swipe_behavior.swipe_interaction: First-class horizontal swipe tracks (StudioGarmentSwiper) across Tops, Bottoms, Footwear, and optional Outerwear.
browsing_and_swipe_behavior.performance: Swiping already-known wardrobe items executes deterministically with zero ML inference overhead and immediate visual responsiveness.

live_insights_and_colour_reasoning.instant_feedback: Evaluated instantaneously on every garment change without user pressing 'Generate'.
live_insights_and_colour_reasoning.weak_combination_handling: Detects competing strong accents and provides constructive, specific advice (e.g. 'The vibrant top competes with the bottom. A darker neutral bottom creates cleaner visual balance.')

complete_outfit_and_vto.hero_canvas: EditorialOutfitCanvas presents the complete look flat-lay in natural proportions with natural overlap.
complete_outfit_and_vto.try_it_on_entry: Optional post-styling CTA ('Want to see it on you? [Try It On] [Not Now]'). Never automatically launches virtual try-on.
complete_outfit_and_vto.personal_aura_model: Persistent personal model architecture via MirrorService. Reference photo uploaded once, stored securely on device, and reused for all future styling combinations.

vto_readiness_governance.actual_pipeline_state: Preparation State (honest user disclosure: 'Virtual Try-On is being prepared for this combination')
vto_readiness_governance.scientific_integrity: Strictly verified (no OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Replicate, FASHN calls)
